data.name: Dhrushti
data.gender_notes: Dhrushti is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘dṛṣṭi’, meaning ‘sight’ or ‘vision’. In Hindu mythology, Dhrushti is the goddess of sight and the power of perception. She is also known as the divine power of observation and understanding. The name Dhrushti carries the meaning “Sight, Vision” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dhrushti usually hope their child will grow to embody sight, vision and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the ability to see beyond the physical world and perceive the spiritual truths.
data.etymology: Dhrushti belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sight, Vision.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dhrushti total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Dhrushti holds immense significance in Hindu culture due to its association with the goddess of sight and perception. This name is believed to bestow upon the bearer the power of keen observation and a deep understanding of the world around them. Dhrushti is revered as a symbol of clarity and insight, making it a highly esteemed name within the Hindu community.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Dhrushti holds deep significance as it represents the inner ability to see beyond the physical realm and perceive the deeper truths of life. The name is believed to be a reminder of the importance of spiritual growth and the power of inner perception in achieving enlightenment and self-realization. Furthermore, Dhrushti is a symbol of the divine power of discernment and inspiration, inspiring one to listen to their inner voice and make wise decisions in life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Dhrushti: Goddess of clear and true vision. Her name signifies the ability to see beyond the physical world, gaining wisdom and insight into the deeper meaning of life.
